ios.desc:
Inspired by Getting Things Done®, Nirvana is your trusted space to capture all your to-dos, organize with intention, and focus on what matters right now.

Ever feel like you're juggling too much? Nirvana offers a gentle, flexible way to get things done—no pressure, no clutter, no guilt.

Here's how it works

• Capture to-dos as they pop up
• Clarify what needs doing and what can wait
• Organize using Projects, Areas, and Tags
• Review regularly to stay on track
• Engage with what's most important right now

Smart views that help you focus

• Next — things you can do anytime
• Scheduled — to do in the future
• Someday — ideas on the back burner

Everything stays in sync across your devices, so you can check in whenever, wherever.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

"Your mind is for having ideas, not holding them." — David Allen

Whether you're balancing work, creative projects, family life, or all of the above, Nirvana frees your mind with the confidence that everything is captured and nothing gets missed.

"It's by far the best GTD app I have used (and I've tried them all!)." — Damian Surr

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Questions, suggestions, or want to learn more?  Visit https://www.nirvanahq.com or email us at support@nirvanahq.com
